subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw allow models to clear terminal or paused goals through a model-callable `clear_goal` tool, and what cleared-goal retention contract should core persist?
rationale: Current docs reserve goal clearing and replacement for operator/session controls, while the proposal would expand model authority and add a new canonical session history surface.

options.title: Keep operator-only clearing
options.body: Preserve the current docs and require users or session controls to clear goals before a model can create a new one.

options.title: Allow terminal-only model clearing
options.body: Approve a `clear_goal` tool only for terminal states with bounded canonical session history and no active-goal clearing.

options.title: Use operator confirmation
options.body: Add a non-destructive model request or status flag that asks the operator to clear/archive the goal instead of letting the model remove it directly.

recommendation.title: Allow terminal-only model clearing
recommendation.body: Approve a `clear_goal` tool only for terminal states with bounded canonical session history and no active-goal clearing.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person introduced core session goals and most recently changed goal controls, making them the best available owner for the product boundary choice.
